snippet.title: Mini Army
snippet.description:
A new take on the Snake game genre: grow your army and defeat the opponents. Unlock new armies to play with, and new desktops to play on.

Comes with online global rankings and achievements

Read all about the game: http://www.orangepixel.net/miniarmy/
